summary: Complete playable HTML with exploration, progression, persistence, and UI elements for Eldoria Chronicles
expectedEffect: Enhanced gameplay with exploration, progression, persistence, and UI elements for Eldoria Chronicles

replaceFiles.content:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="ko">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover">
  <meta name="theme-color" content="#08111b">
  <title>엘도리아 연대기</title>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="/web-games/_shared/styles.css">
</head>
<body>
  <script>
    window.GAME_CONFIG = {
      id: 'seed-story-complete-rpg-chronicles-of-eldoria',
      name: '엘도리아 연대기',
      mode: 'eldoria',
      hp: 100,
      desc: '회색 숲에서 엘도리아의 심장까지 5개 장을 탐험하고 전투·휴식·장비 강화를 선택하는 완결형 RPG.',
      story: '탐색과 전투로 골드를 모으고 장비를 강화해 다섯 장의 이야기를 끝내라.'
    };

    // Initialize game state
    let gameState = {
      progress: 0,
      inventory: [],
      gold: 0,
      currentLocation: 0,
      isPaused: false,
      isGameActive: true
    };

    // Game logic here
    function startGame() {
      gameState.progress = 0;
      gameState.inventory = [];
      gameState.gold = 0;
      gameState.currentLocation = 0;
      gameState.isPaused = false;
      gameState.isGameActive = true;
      console.log('Game started');
    }

    // Handle user input
    function handleInput(event) {
      if (event.type === 'keydown') {
        if (event.key === 'ArrowLeft') {
          gameState.currentLocation--;
        } else if (event.key === 'ArrowRight') {
          gameState.currentLocation++;
        }
      }
    }

    // Update game state
    function updateGame() {
      if (gameState.isGameActive) {
        gameState.progress++;
        if (gameState.progress >= 5) {
          alert('Game completed!');
        }
      }
    }

    // Main game loop
    function gameLoop() {
      updateGame();
      requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
    }

    // Start the game
    startGame();
    gameLoop();
  </script>
  <script src="/web-games/_shared/vibe2-final.js"></script>
</body>
</html>
